description: Frozen IPC wire format specification for blackgate_pipeline C engine. The Rust replacement MUST produce byte-identical output for all stdout/stderr/unix-socket formats below.

stdin.protocol: First line after spawn is the init route config JSON (blocking read). Subsequent lines are runtime commands (async via GIOChannel watch).

route_init_json.description: Sent once at startup. Blocking read before pipeline enters PLAYING.

runtime_commands.description: Sent after pipeline startup for live control.

stdout.format: prefix-matched text lines, trailing newline, unbuffered (setvbuf _IONBF)

startup_bootstrap:
Argument <count>: <arg1>
Waiting for JSON input...
Received JSON: <full_config>
Connected to the socket.
source_lifecycle:
SOURCE_VALID:primary
SOURCE_VALID:secondary
SOURCE_INVALID:primary <error_message>
SOURCE_INVALID:secondary <error_message>
SOURCE_INVALID:<source_name>
FIRST_BUFFER_RECEIVED
sdi_diagnostics:
SDI_AUDIO_SILENT: device=<n> no_audio_for=<seconds>s total_buffers=<n>
SDI_AUDIO_RECOVERED: device=<n> audio_buffers_flowing_again
pipeline_errors:
Pipeline Warning from <element>: <message>
Error: <error_message>
Error parsing JSON
connection_events: New SRT caller connection to <addr> from <addr> (stream_id: <id>)

stderr.direction: C → Elixir (Elixir reads Port stderr as {:stderr, data})
stderr.format: free-form diagnostics, g_printerr() calls
stderr.note: Used for: state change diagnostics, parse errors, link failures, SDI fallback warnings, element creation failures, command errors

unix_socket.format: concatenated JSON objects with literal separator + newline terminators

route_id_announcement.note: TWO send() calls: first 'route_id:', then argv[1]. Elixir side reads them concatenated.

source_stats_stream_id.sent: When source stream ID is detected (line 1010-1011)

route_health.sent: On pipeline state changes and errors

index_of_all_output_patterns._comment: Every printf/g_print line from gst_pipeline.c captured for exact reproduction in Rust. Byte-identical output is MANDATORY.

unix_socket.note: Two send() calls, Elixir reads concatenated

unix_socket_note: The source stats and sink stats are sent as SEPARATE send() calls (lines 545-546 and 886-888). They are NOT concatenated into one JSON object. Elixir's unix_sock_handler.ex reads them as separate messages. The Elixir side then reconstructs them into the combined format.
socket_type_fix: unix_socket.c uses SOCK_STREAM (TCP-like), NOT SOCK_DGRAM. The Rust replacement must use UnixStream, not UnixDatagram.
